title: Telecom complaint investigation and controlled service credits
brief: Design a complaint assistant for a telecom provider. Customers report network outages, poor speed and billing errors. The assistant should investigate using account, billing and service records, explain findings and resolve eligible service credits. Larger or unclear refunds need a human supervisor and may wait up to 48 hours. Keep customers informed, avoid duplicate refunds and use only the right customer's active service connection. Propose any missing policies as assumptions, not real company rules.

assumptions.statement: Proposed v1 serves authenticated consumer postpaid active connections in one tenant and currency; prepaid, enterprise, closed-service and cash-refund execution use an owned supervisor case.
assumptions.why: Bound the ledger and eligibility semantics.
assumptions.validation: Confirm supported segments, currency and meaning of active with operations.

assumptions.statement: Illustrative policy P1 allows outage credits only: verified outage overlap of at least 60 minutes; credit=floor(monthly base fee minor units * affected minutes / billing-cycle minutes), limited by remaining eligible base fee. If the computed entitlement before the 1000-minor-unit automatic cap exceeds that cap, route the whole claim to a supervisor; do not silently cap and close it. Automatic credit is at most 1000 minor units per incident. Billing errors, poor speed without verified outage, larger amounts and uncertainty require supervisor review.
assumptions.why: A concrete safe policy is needed to design the action boundary; these are not company rules.
assumptions.validation: Approve a versioned eligibility table, rounding, taxes, overlap rules, limits and customer consent requirements before writes.

assumptions.statement: Proposed APIs support tenant/customer/connection scoping, active-state versions, immutable policy versions, atomic incident credit uniqueness, durable operation lookup and fresh authorization at the billing writer.
assumptions.why: The design cannot establish actual adapter capabilities.
assumptions.validation: Prove these semantics in sandbox including unknown commit, conflicts and revoked permission. No autonomous credits if unavailable.

assumptions.statement: Proposed supervisor queue has a 48 elapsed-hour decision deadline from initial referral, acknowledgement within 15 minutes, updates at receipt and every 12 hours, escalation to duty lead at 36 hours and overdue transfer at 48 hours without approval by silence.
assumptions.why: Brief supplies 48 hours but no staffing, clock or update cadence.
assumptions.validation: Confirm 24/7 staffing, elapsed UTC timer, escalation acceptance and notification channels.

assumptions.statement: Proposed privacy defaults keep full case evidence for 30 days and minimized financial audit references for 365 days, encrypted in tenant-resident storage; no raw payment details or entire bills in model prompts.
assumptions.why: Retention and residency require company approval.
assumptions.validation: Verify applicable retention, deletion, residency and model-provider terms before real data.

assumptions.statement: Illustrative planning assumptions are 10000 complaints/month, 80% reaching model investigation, 10% of those needing one schema retry; model budget prices are $2/input million and $8/output million tokens, not a vendor quote.
assumptions.why: Reproducible capacity and budget without invented measured data.
assumptions.validation: Measure shadow branch mix, token lengths and contracted prices.

assumptions.statement: Proposed credit API posts positive integer minor units as a CREDIT against a named original invoice line and incident; supervisor cannot override active-connection, subject, duplicate or freshness checks. A separate human process owns cash refunds and compensation.
assumptions.why: Avoid introducing an unbounded general refund writer.
assumptions.validation: Confirm ledger allocation, credit semantics, supervisor authority and cash-refund handoff receipt.

assumptions.statement: Proposed authenticated case portal plus consented service notifications use template outbox messages; case status remains accessible if delivery fails.
assumptions.why: Keep customers informed without inventing a live messaging integration.
assumptions.validation: Verify channel consent, accessible templates, delivery receipts and outbox deduplication.

sources.passage: Design a complaint assistant for a telecom provider.

Illustrative policy P1 allows outage credits only: verified outage overlap of at least 60 minutes; credit=floor(monthly base fee minor units * affected minutes / billing-cycle minutes), limited by remaining eligible base fee. If the computed entitlement before the 1000-minor-unit automatic cap exceeds that cap, route the whole claim to a supervisor; do not silently cap and close it. Automatic credit is at most 1000 minor units per incident. Billing errors, poor speed without verified outage, larger amounts and uncertainty require supervisor review.

Proposed APIs support tenant/customer/connection scoping, active-state versions, immutable policy versions, atomic incident credit uniqueness, durable operation lookup and fresh authorization at the billing writer.

Proposed supervisor queue has a 48 elapsed-hour decision deadline from initial referral, acknowledgement within 15 minutes, updates at receipt and every 12 hours, escalation to duty lead at 36 hours and overdue transfer at 48 hours without approval by silence.

Proposed credit API posts positive integer minor units as a CREDIT against a named original invoice line and incident; supervisor cannot override active-connection, subject, duplicate or freshness checks. A separate human process owns cash refunds and compensation.

Illustrative policy P1 allows outage credits only: verified outage overlap of at least 60 minutes; credit=floor(monthly base fee minor units * affected minutes / billing-cycle minutes), limited by remaining eligible base fee. Proposed APIs support tenant/customer/connection scoping, active-state versions, immutable policy versions, atomic incident credit uniqueness, durable operation lookup and fresh authorization at the billing writer.

Proposed supervisor queue has a 48 elapsed-hour decision deadline from initial referral, acknowledgement within 15 minutes, updates at receipt and every 12 hours, escalation to duty lead at 36 hours and overdue transfer at 48 hours without approval by silence.

Proposed credit API posts positive integer minor units as a CREDIT against a named original invoice line and incident; supervisor cannot override active-connection, subject, duplicate or freshness checks. A separate human process owns cash refunds and compensation.

sources.passage: Design a complaint assistant for a telecom provider.

Illustrative policy P1 allows outage credits only: verified outage overlap of at least 60 minutes; credit=floor(monthly base fee minor units * affected minutes / billing-cycle minutes), limited by remaining eligible base fee. Proposed APIs support tenant/customer/connection scoping, active-state versions, immutable policy versions, atomic incident credit uniqueness, durable operation lookup and fresh authorization at the billing writer.

Proposed supervisor queue has a 48 elapsed-hour decision deadline from initial referral, acknowledgement within 15 minutes, updates at receipt and every 12 hours, escalation to duty lead at 36 hours and overdue transfer at 48 hours without approval by silence.

Proposed credit API posts positive integer minor units as a CREDIT against a named original invoice line and incident; supervisor cannot override active-connection, subject, duplicate or freshness checks. A separate human process owns cash refunds and compensation.

sources.passage: Design a complaint assistant for a telecom provider.

Illustrative policy P1 allows outage credits only: verified outage overlap of at least 60 minutes; credit=floor(monthly base fee minor units * affected minutes / billing-cycle minutes), limited by remaining eligible base fee. If the computed entitlement before the 1000-minor-unit automatic cap exceeds that cap, route the whole claim to a supervisor; do not silently cap and close it. Automatic credit is at most 1000 minor units per incident. Billing errors, poor speed without verified outage, larger amounts and uncertainty require supervisor review.

Proposed APIs support tenant/customer/connection scoping, active-state versions, immutable policy versions, atomic incident credit uniqueness, durable operation lookup and fresh authorization at the billing writer.

Proposed supervisor queue has a 48 elapsed-hour decision deadline from initial referral, acknowledgement within 15 minutes, updates at receipt and every 12 hours, escalation to duty lead at 36 hours and overdue transfer at 48 hours without approval by silence.

Proposed credit API posts positive integer minor units as a CREDIT against a named original invoice line and incident; supervisor cannot override active-connection, subject, duplicate or freshness checks. A separate human process owns cash refunds and compensation.

sources.passage: Design a complaint assistant for a telecom provider.
Proposed v1 serves authenticated consumer postpaid active connections in one tenant and currency; prepaid, enterprise, closed-service and cash-refund execution use an owned supervisor case.

Illustrative policy P1 allows outage credits only: verified outage overlap of at least 60 minutes; credit=floor(monthly base fee minor units * affected minutes / billing-cycle minutes), limited by remaining eligible base fee. If the computed entitlement before the 1000-minor-unit automatic cap exceeds that cap, route the whole claim to a supervisor; do not silently cap and close it. Automatic credit is at most 1000 minor units per incident. Billing errors, poor speed without verified outage, larger amounts and uncertainty require supervisor review.

Proposed APIs support tenant/customer/connection scoping, active-state versions, immutable policy versions, atomic incident credit uniqueness, durable operation lookup and fresh authorization at the billing writer.

Proposed supervisor queue has a 48 elapsed-hour decision deadline from initial referral, acknowledgement within 15 minutes, updates at receipt and every 12 hours, escalation to duty lead at 36 hours and overdue transfer at 48 hours without approval by silence.

Proposed privacy defaults keep full case evidence for 30 days and minimized financial audit references for 365 days, encrypted in tenant-resident storage; no raw payment details or entire bills in model prompts.

Proposed credit API posts positive integer minor units as a CREDIT against a named original invoice line and incident; supervisor cannot override active-connection, subject, duplicate or freshness checks. A separate human process owns cash refunds and compensation.
Proposed authenticated case portal plus consented service notifications use template outbox messages; case status remains accessible if delivery fails.

acceptanceCriteria: T1/C1: foreign/inactive connection cannot expose records; multiple active lines produce explicit selection task, not a guessed binding.
T2/C2 and T3/C3: source IDs/versions and insufficient/contradictory/unavailable evidence are preserved; schema retry <=1; no model monetary/tool authority.
T4.1/C4/C6: integer CREDIT payload is immutable and canonical digest reproduced; approval, confirmation, subject, active service, versions, expiry and entitlement checked at commit.
W10-W12: unknown commit freezes incident across sessions; C7 read-only recovery survives expired session, callbacks dedup; no retry absent definitive non-dispatch proof and fresh W11 guard.
C5/W6-W8: receipt, owner, original 48h deadline, 15m acknowledgement alert, 12h updates, 36h escalation and 48h overdue survive worker restart; no silent approval.
C1/C6: cancel versus dispatch linearized; post-dispatch cancel never reverses automatically; finance follow-up receipt retained.
C8: credited requires matching ledger proof; notification recipient/consent/outbox key checked; portal fallback on delivery failure; pending remains pending.
EV1-EV28 and generated EV29 controls run in sandbox with ordered mocks; EV31 enumerates every golden and fails absent evidence; no real policy approval inferred from test pass.
R2-R7 gates and new-write kill switch retain C7/queue continuity; H1-H8 verification roles and evidence visible before live enablement.

C9/W18-W19: CU1 confirms the exact quote with signed digest receipt; 24h expiry/decline/change stops dispatch; customer confirmation does not itself authorize money; EV32-EV34 required in EV31 manifest.

Persist Case(caseId,tenantId,customerId,connectionId,revision,state,originalDueAt,cancellation), Evidence(id,versions,binding), ImmutablePayload(bytes,digest), Approval(scope,digest,expiry,revocation), Operation(operationId,entitlementKey,digest,state,dispatchProof,postingProof), HumanQueue(receipt,owner,sequence,deadline), and transactional Outbox(messageKey,consent,receipt). Use CAS and uniqueness constraints, UTC clock and deterministic policy versioning. Build fake adapters from C2/C5/C6/C7 contracts and EV1-EV28 and EV32-EV34 full fixtures before real integrations. Map every adapter outcome exactly; finance state and durable proof outrank prose. Freeze semantic duplicate candidates and uncertain operations without denying or merging by fuzzy similarity. Build scoped read-only recovery credentials independent of user session; no cash refund/reversal endpoint. Implement cancellation before and after dispatch, crash recovery and virtual 48h timers. Implement EV29-EV31 and R1 metrics, redacted audit logs, tenant filtering, key handling, H5 retention and accessible status templates. Verify real API capabilities in H3 and policy/role/privacy approvals in H1-H8 before enabling writer. Keep feature flag default read-only; separate enablement from deployment. Produce canonical companions and defer PDF generation in this baseline run. After eventual PDF delivery ask exactly once: Would you also like a visual HTML version in the same ten-stage structure as the app? Do not generate HTML without opt-in. Review scores and synthetic tests are design evidence, not production approval. Add Quote/Confirmation records with distinct immutable business revision versus workflow-state revision. C9 receives confirm_credit/decline_credit events directly from scoped portal; workflow entry W1 handles submit/resume/cancel, not confirmation commands. Confirmation events do not change intended business payload; any intent change invalidates quote.
